errors.orsUnreachable: Couldn’t reach OpenRouteService. Check your connection and try again.
errors.orsQuota: OpenRouteService’s free daily limit has been reached. It resets within 24 hours; routes you’ve already viewed and pinned stops still work.
errors.orsTooFar: OpenRouteService can’t plan routes over 6,000 km. If your trip is shorter, a stop was probably found in the wrong country: add the country to its name, e.g. “Nata, Botswana”, or pin it on the map.
errors.placeNotFound: Couldn’t find “{{name}}”. Try a fuller name, e.g. a town or lodge.
errors.noRouteForLeg: OpenRouteService didn’t return a route for this leg.
errors.routePlan: Something went wrong planning this route.
errors.placeSearch: Couldn’t look up places right now.
errors.suppliesBusy: Couldn’t get fuel, water and supplies from OpenStreetMap: its servers are busy or you’re offline. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.supplies: Couldn’t get fuel, water and supplies from OpenStreetMap.
errors.deleteFailed: Couldn’t delete it. Check your connection and try again.
errors.signInForRoutes: Sign in again to plan routes.
errors.orsUserLimit: You’ve planned a lot of routes today. Routes you’ve already looked at still work; try again tomorrow.
errors.signInForSupplies: Sign in again to see fuel, water and supplies.
errors.suppliesUserLimit: You’ve looked up a lot of routes today. What was found before still shows; try again tomorrow.
errors.suppliesOffline: Couldn’t load fuel, water and supplies. Check your connection and try again.

routeOptions.borderTooFar: This leg crosses a border, but OpenRouteService can only route around a border post when the stops are within 150 km of each other in a straight line (these are {{km}} km apart). To compare crossings, add a stop on each side of the border.
routeOptions.noOtherBorder: Couldn’t find a route through a different border crossing.
routeOptions.sameRoad: The other routes OpenRouteService found were practically the same road, so there’s only one option here.
routeOptions.legGone: This leg is no longer part of the trip.
routeOptions.onlyOne: OpenRouteService found only one sensible route for this leg.
routeOptions.useDefault: Go back to the default route
